evidence.detail: The interface defines exactly one operation, void a(rs/x/e), accepting the already-reviewed R29 Stream packet buffer and no unrelated state or lifecycle method.

Client exposes one dispatcher helper a(rs/o/a/a/a): when the client is connected and ISAAC/session state is available it invokes handler.a(Client.fv), where Client.fv is the live incoming Stream, then performs incoming-buffer bookkeeping and packet-dispatch error handling.
Exact v308 contains 52 concrete rs/o/a/a/a/* implementations referencing this interface, forming the complete contiguous stable-ID family immediately after the base contract.

The base is distinct from R115 ScriptPacketHandler: ScriptPacketHandler decodes opcode-250 subprotocol messages, while this interface is invoked directly from the Client's ordinary incoming packet dispatch path with the live Stream.

candidates.note: IncomingPacketHandler is the conservative exact-v308 name for the ordinary server-to-client packet handler contract. Concrete opcode handlers remain separate future recovery work.
